name: 王小安

look.label: 王小安定妆共享提示词
look.zh: 成年东亚男性，年轻清冷气质，修长匀称的模特身形，黑色短发蓬松分层，额前碎发自然垂落，深棕色眼睛，冷白自然肤色，轮廓清晰的鹅蛋脸与利落下颌线，五官精致但保留真实皮肤纹理，神情克制平静，黑色圆领短袖T恤，深灰黑色直筒牛仔裤，白色低帮运动鞋，无饰品，极简现代休闲风，冷灰色无缝棚拍背景
look.en: adult East Asian man with a youthful, cool and restrained presence, tall balanced model-like proportions, short layered black hair with loose wispy fringe, dark brown eyes, naturally fair skin, a defined oval face and clean jawline, refined facial features with realistic skin texture, calm restrained expression, black crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal straight-leg jeans, white low-top sneakers, no accessories, minimalist modern casual styling, cool gray seamless studio background
look.negativeZh: 未成年感, 卡通感, 塑料质感, 过度磨皮, 浓妆, 夸张表情, 张嘴, 胡须, 饰品, 彩色服装, 紧身裤, 多余手指, 肢体变形, 多余人物, 身份漂移
look.negativeEn: underage appearance, cartoon style, plastic texture, over-smoothed skin, heavy makeup, exaggerated expression, open mouth, facial hair, accessories, colorful clothing, skinny trousers, extra fingers, deformed limbs, extra people, identity drift
